b.x: 01 Two signs together: the body tightened, someone else’s course, an ask that takes you off the light. You are being read. Do not wait for the third.
02 A short phrase, the same one: ‘No, thank you.’ ‘I don’t know.’ ‘I’m late.’ No paragraph. Justification is the other’s time.
03 Body toward light, people, an open shop, a camera. Not the hall, the stair, the gap, the stopped car, the ‘come here I’ll show you’.
04 If you already entered the second place: go back to the mouth of the street. Do not go deeper. A free hand. One free ear. Phone in the pocket until the room holds.
05 Emergency numbers on the tongue, not on the stage. Call with a metre of margin. Do not argue. Do not film. Do not prove you are not afraid.

06 Twelve seconds in the head: people and light five steps away? A course that copies? An ask to stop? Body wants to go? Is the no accepted or do they close in? Three yes: you already have the answer.
